lastResponse.text: Yes. I’ll go slow. Take one breath with me. Are you bleeding heavily right now, or feeling like you might faint? If yes, this is urgent, so please call nine one one now, and keep the baby close and safe while help is coming. If someone is with you, ask them to call for you. I can stay on the line with you while you do it.
